technical.summary: Mixed signals with long-term bullish structure but weak intermediate trend, negative momentum indicators, and no triggered strategies; insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: YUM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 75 days.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: low — small to medium amounts, junior/mid-tier members
sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (VIX-like 25 score) with bearish AAII sentiment creates contrarian buy opportunity; congressional selling is weak and dated (107+ days old), providing minimal conviction signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (375.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve and flat DXY provide minimal offset; earnings in 75 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (price above 200-EMA, SMA 50/200 bullish) combined with extreme market fear creating contrarian buy opportunity near support at 113.41.
debate.key_bear_argument: Intermediate trend completely broken (price below EMA-50, EMA-20/50 misaligned), momentum deeply negative (AO, CMF, Hull MA all bearish), no triggered strategies, high earnings risk in 75 days, and macro crisis regime (VIX 375.2) override any long-term bullish structure.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme market fear creates contrarian opportunity and price sits at support near 113.41, intermediate trend deterioration (price below EMA-50, negative momentum across AO/CMF/Hull MA) combined with crisis-regime VIX (375.2) and 75-day earnings risk make risk/reward unfavorable for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Macro crisis regime (VIX 375.2) and broken intermediate trend could drive further downside below support; earnings event in 75 days adds binary event risk that negates swing trade thesis.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, and risk agents all bearish; sentiment contrarian signal insufficient to override structural weakness
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding YUM position with 25 existing Consumer Discretionary positions (7% sector concentration); adding here increases concentration risk without conviction improvement.
